description: Phase-1 retrieval benchmark, seeded from the thesis domain (Data-Centric AI / dataset pruning) plus four near-miss concept pairs. Grades live in qrels.json.

relevance_scale.2: highly relevant — the paper is about this concept
relevance_scale.1: partially relevant — adjacent method or shared vocabulary
relevance_scale.0: explicitly irrelevant — judged near-miss, not merely unlabeled

notes: Unlabeled papers are not treated as relevant. Precision/nDCG are pessimistic because judgments are incomplete.
Recall@k, MRR, and HitRate are the primary metrics. Hard-pair leak measures concept confusion.
Corpus is arXiv cs.LG/AI/CL/CV + stat.ML from 2021 onward, so classic pre-2021 papers are out of scope.

queries.text: dataset pruning and data subset selection for deep neural networks
neural network weight pruning and model sparsity
queries.notes: Hard negative for dataset_pruning: same word 'pruning', different object.

queries.text: training data selection for deep learning
queries.notes: Broader phrasing of dataset pruning / coreset / data diet.

queries.text: feature selection and variable selection for machine learning
queries.notes: Hard negative for data_selection: selects dimensions, not training examples.
Synthesize a small training set, not compress a teacher network.

queries.text: knowledge distillation from teacher to student networks
queries.notes: Hard negative for dataset_distillation: same word 'distillation', different object.

queries.text: coreset selection for deep neural network training
queries.notes: Overlaps dataset pruning; contrast with active learning.

queries.text: active learning for deep neural networks
queries.notes: Hard-ish pair with coreset_selection: both pick examples, different labeling protocol.

queries.text: data-centric AI methods for improving training data quality
queries.notes: Survey / framing papers around the thesis area.
Thesis-specific: scoring proxies (EL2N, GraNd, forgetting, influence) used to prune data.

hard_pairs.why: SPECTER2 previously mixed network-pruning papers into dataset-pruning queries.
Shared 'selection' vocabulary; object is examples vs features.
Shared 'distillation' vocabulary; object is data vs model.
Both select examples; active learning queries labels, coresets subset a labeled set.
